**Management Summary – Project LV 163,933 €**

The tender documentation contains numerous high‑ and medium‑severity gaps that jeopardize compliance with STLB‑Bau, VOB/C and GEG standards and expose the contractor to unpriced risk. Critical omissions (total ≈ 13 k€) include waste‑disposal specifications, asphalt binder and wearing‑course data, shaft and pipe details, frost‑protection material, and mandatory thermal‑insulation values. Medium‑level deficiencies (≈ 7 k€) affect concrete pavement layout, site‑establishment scope, masonry standards, cement screed data, and interior plaster specifications. These gaps will trigger change orders, delay approvals and increase audit exposure. Immediate actions: (1) revise all missing technical specifications and reference standards; (2) quantify and allocate the identified cost impacts; (3) update risk allocation clauses to avoid unfair burden on the contractor.
